supersedes.reason: adds technical-value status; binds no new numeric budget

critical_statements: THIS IS AN UNSIGNED STRUCTURE. IT IS NOT A WARRANT. IT AUTHORIZES NOTHING.
No new numeric pre-launch budget was bound in this lane.
The repaired broker advances ENFORCEABILITY, not AUTHORITY.
The obsolete PRQ-07 independent-integration-review blocker is discharged and is NOT carried forward.
Zero source access, locator discovery, warrant issuance, live C4, production mutation, C7 or actor/person work was performed.

two_fact_law.measurable_enforceable: Can the quantity be counted and capped BEFORE the operation?
two_fact_law.numeric_budget_known: Does an exact/floor/zero/max PRE-LAUNCH value exist?
two_fact_law.rule: An enforceable-but-unbounded account is NOT a bound budget. Reporting it as one would fabricate authority.

two_stage_law.stage_2_during_run_MEASURED: exact observed count, retained on return
two_stage_law.law: Freeze expected budgets and instrumentation before launch; retain measured counts.

mandatory_separate_accounts: file hash passes (full SHA-256 over the file)
settled_o1_c07_structure.non_substitutability: Literal path opens, reader invocations and decoder invocations are separately named, non-substitutable quantities. A higher-level proxy may not be renamed path_opens.
settled_o1_c07_structure.REQUIRED_EXACT_COUNT_meaning: The budget must be exact before launch. It does NOT mean the final observed number must already have been observed before launch.

typed_null_law.rule: A typed null may describe an unexecuted or unmeasurable RETURN metric only where the governing failure law allows it. A typed null may NOT waive a mandatory pre-launch budget.

machine_readable_rule.rationale: An absent or null pre-launch budget would silently waive a launch prerequisite. An UNBOUND_PENDING_TECHNICAL_ACCEPTANCE budget is an explicit, non-waiving blocker.

never: a null standing in for an unbound pre-launch budget

EXACT.meaning: Authority froze a specific count. The observed count must equal it.

MAX.meaning: Authority froze a ceiling. The observed count may be lower but never higher.

ZERO.meaning: Hard zero. A single non-zero observation is a STOP condition, not a reportable variance.

FLOOR.meaning: Authority froze a minimum that must be reached. It is NOT a ceiling and MUST NOT be promoted to one.
FLOOR.example: SRC27 metadata_reads floor = 1, from the 'at minimum' wording of the hardened note

UNBOUND_PENDING_TECHNICAL_ACCEPTANCE.meaning: Authority named the account as mandatory but supplied no number. The value awaits technical acceptance. This is a TYPED BUDGET STATE, not a null, and it waives nothing.
UNBOUND_PENDING_TECHNICAL_ACCEPTANCE.example: path_level_opens on the six non-SRC27 sources

candidate_extra_tracked_accounts.purpose: Recorded so they are never relabeled into an O1-C07 account.

logical_views.counts_what: position-zero rewinds of the SAME physical open, one per logical parse
logical_views.relabeling_prohibition: A logical view is NOT a path open. It must never be reported as, or added into, the path_opens account. The candidate reports it separately for exactly this reason.

reader_invocations.counts_what: total compiled-reader calls of any kind
reader_invocations.relabeling_prohibition: A reader invocation is NOT a decoder invocation. See decoder_invocations.

reader_read_calls.counts_what: read() calls the compiled reader made through the governed view
reader_read_calls.relabeling_prohibition: Read-call count is not a byte count and not an open count.

chunk_reads.counts_what: compiled-reader invocations issued by the governed row_offset loop
chunk_reads.relabeling_prohibition: chunk_reads is row-count dependent and must never be conflated with metadata_reads, selected_reads or full_reads.

GOV-SCOPE-001.finding: No per-source session owner exists, so NO count account can be shown exact at the governed warrant scope.

commission_premise_checked.evidence: git grep 'GovernedSourceSession' over the candidate tree returns zero occurrences.

why_counts_are_scope_blocked: SourceAccessBroker is constructed per _decode() invocation (decoder:588), so its scope is ONE DECODE CALL, not one warrant source entry.
There is no per-source session registry, no session_for(source), and no per_source mapping anywhere in the candidate tree.

Nothing in the closure enforces or records that exactly one _decode occurs per source. A caller that decodes twice, or re-decodes after a mismatch, produces two opens and nothing at the warrant layer detects or forbids it.
Broker release is caller-responsible via PhysicalSourceIncidence.close_source_access(); there is no __del__ and no finalizer, so the governed open's lifetime is NOT frozen.
SourceBackedC11SessionCache (facade:612) caches derived C11 releases keyed by source_sha256. It is not a physical session owner and neither supplies nor refutes a one-open scope.

what_the_candidate_audit_does_and_does_n.proves: A static AST audit of the accepted C4 closure (21 accepted modules + the broker = 22) finds exactly ONE source-path open SITE, at broker:326 open(self.path), and ZERO raw path strings reaching pyreadstat. The auditor carries a positive control: the same auditor reports 2 raw-path reader calls in the out-of-closure WVS7 materializer, so the zero is a real negative and not a broken query. The auditor also documents three of its own false-zero defects that were found and fixed.
what_the_candidate_audit_does_and_does_n.does_not_prove: A count of open SITES is not a count of opens PER SOURCE at the governed warrant scope. The candidate's own SourceAccessBudget docstring states its caps are 'policy ceilings whose purpose is to STOP a run; they are not claims about expected behaviour'. The default path_opens=1 is therefore a stop-cap, not evidence of scope.

GOV-SCOPE-001.missing_owner_named: A warrant/execution-surface-level per-source session owner that (a) is constructed once per bound source entry, (b) is shared by every admitted source operation for that source, (c) is closed deterministically rather than by caller discipline, and (d) makes the aggregate per-source counts enforceable at that scope.

GOV-DEC-003.finding: The O1-C07 mandatory account 'decoder invocations' has no counter and therefore no owner in the repaired candidate.
GOV-DEC-003.evidence: 'decoder_invocations' has zero occurrences in pre553_source_access_broker.py. SourceAccessAccount exposes reader_invocations (compiled-reader calls of any kind) but no decoder-entry counter, and receipt().measurement_basis lists no decoder-invocation basis.
GOV-DEC-003.consequence: This account is NOT measurable or enforceable in the candidate, independently of the scope blocker. reader_invocations is a different quantity and is not a substitute: under the settled non-substitutability law a reader invocation may not be renamed a decoder call.
GOV-DEC-003.missing_owner_named: A decoder-entry counter at the _decode boundary, distinct from reader_invocations, with its own pre-operation cap.

GOV-HDR-002.finding: The repaired candidate performs a header-prefix read for EVERY source, but frozen authority admits a header-prefix read only for SRC26.
GOV-HDR-002.evidence: rawlsing_next/pre553_physical_decoder.py:639 calls broker.header_prefix(176 if source_format == 'SAV' else 512) unconditionally, outside any operation-class branch. The result is consumed by _file_metadata_contract(..., raw_prefix=raw_prefix), so the R35-I01 physical metadata digest requires it.
GOV-HDR-002.consequence: On the SRC02/SRC06/SRC14 selected route, and on SRC08/SRC12/SRC27, the candidate would perform a header-prefix read that the admitted operation class does not cover. This is a SCOPE EXCESS relative to frozen authority, not merely an unbound accounting value.
GOV-HDR-002.why_not_a_bound_value: Binding header_prefix_reads=1 for those six sources would authorise an operation the operation class does not admit. Binding 0 would contradict the candidate's control flow. Both are wrong, so the value stays typed and the discrepancy is raised as its own item.
GOV-HDR-002.src26_note: SRC26 keeps FLOOR 1 from HQ196, reviewer-flagged. Authority supplies the BYTE count 176, not a read count. The DTA constant 512 is candidate-chosen and is NOT authority-frozen.
